query: SELECT CASE WHEN category_confidence IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN category_confidence<55 THEN '0-54' WHEN category_confidence<70 THEN '55-69' WHEN category_confidence<85 THEN '70-84' ELSE '85-100' END AS band,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE last_verified_at>=now()-interval '60 days') AS fresh FROM shopify_store_index WHERE status='verified' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
